newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
The turnover rose to 3.099 billion yuan from 2.825 billion on Tuesday and the 30-day contract still the most active one.
Traders said the day's trading was more active than early this week with some short-term financial centres participating.
"New listings on the domestic A share markets are a positive factor for the market," one broker said.
"The downward trend of the rates since late January will be stopped due to active buying from some big non-banking financial institutions this week," one local trader said.
The expectations of cuts in the bank interest rates and the bank reserve rates prevented major state-run banks from trading actively, he said.

"The gaps between the rates and the treasury bill repo rates will encourage more non-banking financial institutions to enter the interbank market in the next few days if the repo rates remain at high levels," said a second trader.
